description: Verify a token's successful finalized top-level creation transaction and return known verified deployments by that sender with stored scans. Coverage grows as creation proofs are submitted. Does not discover every deployment, trace launchpad/internal CREATE, attribute a team, or label a deployer a scammer. Costs $0.005 per successful call in USDC on Base, paid with x402 in the call's _meta; failed calls are free.

chain.description: bsc (BNB Smart Chain, the default), eth (Ethereum) or base (Base)

creation_tx.description: Actual top-level contract creation transaction, not pair creation

name: deployer-report
